title: Nutty Fluffy Rice Bake
description: A simple and delicious side dish made with fluffy rice, nutty flavor, and a hint of Chinese spices.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine Nutty Rice, Fluffy White Rice, Chinese Five-Spice, and Bake Mix.
Gradually add Water to the bowl and mix until the ingredients are well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the rice is cooked and fluffy.
Remove from oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
